<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify numeric indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Keep original values for cluster profiles (before imputation/scaling)
original_values = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Median imputation
imputed = df[indicator_cols].copy()
for col in indicator_cols:
    median_val = df[col].median()
    imputed[col] = imputed[col].fillna(median_val)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled = scaler.fit_transform(imputed)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
clusters = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled)

# Write city_clusters.csv
df_clusters = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']].copy()
df_clusters['cluster_id'] = clusters
df_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Write cluster_profiles.csv
# Mean of raw indicator values per cluster, computed over non-missing values
profiles = []
for cluster_id in range(3):
    mask = clusters == cluster_id
    cluster_data = original_values[mask]
    profile = {'cluster_id': cluster_id}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        profile[col] = cluster_data[col].mean()  # mean over non-missing values only
    profiles.append(profile)

df_profiles = pd.DataFrame(profiles)
df_profiles.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
